summary.intent: Coordinate a v5 restructuring of the wisp-plugins repo: a subagent deletes eight old plugins while separate tracks build the new `wisp` core and `wisp-packs`, to be integrated afterwards.
summary.outcome: The deletion track finished and committed locally (c85456c7, unpushed). Seven of nine checks pass; `versions`, `claude-manifests` and `test` (5 handback-validator failures) fail pending integration. Integration is waiting on the wisp core and wisp-packs tracks.

repo: `just check` stops at the first failing recipe (`test`), so each recipe has to be run separately to see the full status.
`versions` and `claude-manifests` fail whenever a changelog entry's version is ahead of `plugin.json`; they clear once versions are bumped to 5.0.0.

Codex and Antigravity harness copies live under `harnesses/codex/plugins/` and `harnesses/codex/catalog.json`. `.agents/plugins` and `dist/codex` are generated by `just marketplace-sync` and should not be hand-edited.
`shared/hooks/validate-handback.py` has a `ROUTES` table. `test_handback_validator.test_every_route_names_an_existing_schema` requires an agent file for every route, so deleting agents breaks it.

`tests/test_reference_integrity.py` now has a `NO_CALLER_YET` allowlist for eight shared references that nothing calls yet (language verification, boundary-values, remediation, interface-coverage, implementation-review). It is temporary and meant to be pruned.
Root README links to plugin directories are link-tested, so `wisp` and `wisp-packs` are named without links until their directories land.
Several tests pin file lists (`test_skill_routing`, `test_outcome_baseline`, `test_spec_unknowns`); they now have empty or reduced lists with comments saying where to add entries.

code.finding: The ROUTES entries for muse, ranger, scribe, sentinel and smith `:exit-gate` point at deleted agents and must be pruned. A route for the wisp verifier has to be added.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user instructions. They are summarized and acted on only within the session's permissions.
Work was split into parallel worktree tracks (delete, wisp core, wisp-packs) with a single integration step at the end.
Known-expected check failures should be separated from real ones and reported explicitly.

friction: `just check` halts at the first failing recipe, which hides later failures.
The deletion subagent could not clear the handback-validator failures because the hook and test were outside its scope.
Links to `wisp` and `wisp-packs` could not be added because their directories are not in the deletion worktree.
open_items: Prune the deleted exit-gate routes from `validate-handback.py` and its test, and add the wisp verifier route.
Bump muse (1.2.0) and courier (3.2.0) to 5.0.0, plus the root version and changelog.
Add marketplace entries for `wisp` and `wisp-packs`, link them in the root README, and add Codex/AGY install lines.
Prune the `NO_CALLER_YET` allowlist once wisp consumes those references.

Clean up stale old-plugin names in `shared/harness-authoring.md`, `shared/agent-best-practices.md`, the `plugins/mason` README, changelog and agents, and `tests/fixtures/behavioral/implementation-verification.json`.

Historical docs (`verified-facts`, `architecture-assumptions`, `docs/adr`, `docs/evaluations`, `docs/evaluation-runbook.md` line 63) still mention `smith` and `/guide:fix`; they were intentionally left as records.
Merge the deletion branch once the wisp core and wisp-packs tracks report, and push, since nothing has been pushed.
